me.title: All Video Downloader & Saver
me.summary: Fast video downloader for HD videos, stories, clips and offline viewing
me.description:
Save the videos you love and enjoy them anytime with All Video Downloader & Saver, a simple, fast and convenient video downloader built for everyday use.
Copy a supported video link, paste it into the app and save the video directly to your device. Whether you want to keep short videos, stories, status videos or useful clips, the built-in video saver makes downloading and managing media easy.
KEY FEATURES
• Fast Video Downloader
Save supported online videos quickly with a smooth and straightforward download process.
• HD Video Saver
Download available videos in clear, high-quality formats for a better offline viewing experience.
• Simple Link-Based Downloading
Copy a video link from a supported source, paste it into the app and start the download in just a few taps.
• Story and Status Saver
Keep supported stories, status videos and short clips on your device before they disappear.
• Offline Video Access
Watch downloaded videos whenever you want, even when an internet connection is unavailable.
• Download Manager
View download progress and keep your saved videos organised in one convenient place.
• Easy Video Controls
Open, play, share or delete downloaded videos directly from the app.
• Clean and User-Friendly Design
A simple interface helps you save videos without complicated steps.
HOW TO DOWNLOAD A VIDEO
Copy the link of the video you have permission to save.
Open All Video Downloader & Saver.
Paste the link into the download field.
Tap the download button.
Open the saved video and enjoy it offline.
WHY USE ALL VIDEO DOWNLOADER & SAVER?
All Video Downloader & Saver combines a fast video downloader, HD video saver, story saver and offline media manager in one practical app.
It is designed for users who want a quick way to save supported social media videos and keep their favourite clips available on their device.
Use the app for personal videos, educational clips, creative references, memorable stories and other content that you own or are authorised to download.
IMPORTANT
Features, supported websites and downloadable formats may vary depending on the source and content availability.
Please respect copyright and intellectual property rights. Download or share only content that you own, content in the public domain, or content for which you have permission from the owner.
All Video Downloader & Saver is an independent application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any social media platform.
